learning_outcomes.text: Be able to use the method of separation of variables for solving second-order partial differential equations and to classify them.
Be able to apply the method of characteristics and separation of variables for solving classical partial differential equations.
Be able to solve first and second-order ordinary differential equations and to know how to model real situations using these equations.
Know how to implement numerical methods for the approximate solution of ordinary and partial differential equations.
Know how to apply the method of characteristics for integrating first-order partial differential equations.

syllabus_topics: Cauchy problem. Existence and uniqueness of the solution
Problems associated with ordinary differential equations
Applications: Cooling problems, Newtonian Mechanics, Mixture problems, Orthogonal trajectories
Homogeneous linear equations with constant coefficients
Non-homogeneous linear equations with constant coefficients. Applications of linear ODEs
Systems of linear differential equations. Applications of systems
Numerical solution of ordinary and partial differential equations
Finite difference methods for ordinary and partial differential equations
